_說明: 週教案:同一單元拆成 5 天,每天的複習階段固定回收前幾天教過的項目(手動版間隔重複)。前端會依日期自動推進天數(同一天重複上課會上同一天的課),也可用畫面上的下拉選單手動指定第幾天。
unit: Unit 3 Can I Have a Balloon?(請求允許)

week.focus: 句型 Can I have...? + 派對場景

stages.label: 開場暖身
stages.goal: Greet the student warmly BY NAME, make light small talk with ONE simple question (feel free to use their interests), then tell them: this week we learn how to ASK FOR things politely in English. Today: asking at a birthday party.

stages.label: 暖身舊字
stages.goal: Warm up with these easy words the student already knows. ONE at a time: ask them to say it in English, wait, give gentle feedback.

stages.label: 主題課程
stages.goal: Teach today's items ONE at a time: say it, show it with show_image (for nouns), give the Chinese meaning, have the student repeat, then log it with log_vocabulary. Drill the pattern by swapping in different nouns. Then run the activity.

items.chinese: 我可以要一個……嗎?(禮貌請求句型)
items.example: Can I have a peach, please?
Can I have a yellow balloon, please?
Can I have a red balloon, please?

stages.activity: Role-play: a birthday party. YOU are the host, the STUDENT is a guest. The guest asks for things with 'Can I have ___, please?' (balloon, spoon, cake, juice...). Flow: greet → student asks → you hand it over → thank you → next item. If the student freezes, feed the line in Chinese first, then let them say it in English.

stages.label: 總結
stages.goal: Wrap up in simple terms (Chinese is fine): today we learned to ask politely with 'Can I have ___, please?'. Praise ONE specific thing the student did well. Tell them tomorrow we learn how to ANSWER. Say goodbye warmly.

week.focus: 回應句型 Sure/No sorry + 點心店場景

stages.label: 開場暖身
stages.goal: Greet the student BY NAME, ONE short small-talk question, then remind them: yesterday we learned to ASK for things. Today we learn how to ANSWER when someone asks US.

stages.label: 複習
stages.goal: Review yesterday's items ONE at a time: prompt the student to use each one in a sentence, wait for their answer, gently fix mistakes by restating.

stages.label: 主題課程
stages.goal: Teach today's items ONE at a time (show_image for nouns, log_vocabulary for new items). Practice BOTH answers: saying yes and saying no politely. Then run the activity.

items.chinese: 當然可以,拿去吧。(答應時)
items.example: Can I have a peach? — Sure. Here you are.

items.chinese: 不行,抱歉。(拒絕時,可委婉說原因)
items.example: Can I borrow your ruler? — No. Sorry.

stages.activity: Role-play: a snack shop. ROUND 1: you are the shopkeeper, the student asks 'Can I have/buy ___?' and you answer 'Sure. Here you are.' or 'No. Sorry.' ROUND 2: SWAP ROLES — the student is the shopkeeper and must answer YOUR requests with 'Sure...' or 'No. Sorry.' Keep exchanges short.

stages.label: 總結
stages.goal: Wrap up in simple terms: today we learned both answers, 'Sure. Here you are.' and 'No. Sorry.'. Praise ONE specific thing. Tell them tomorrow is about BORROWING things. Say goodbye warmly.

week.focus: 句型 Can I borrow...? + 教室借文具場景

stages.label: 開場暖身
stages.goal: Greet the student BY NAME, ONE short small-talk question, then introduce today's topic: BORROWING things from friends at school.

stages.label: 複習
stages.goal: Review these items from the past two days, ONE at a time: prompt the student to use each, wait, gently fix by restating.

items.english: Sure. Here you are. / No. Sorry.
items.chinese: 當然可以,拿去吧。/不行,抱歉。

stages.label: 主題課程
stages.goal: Teach today's items ONE at a time (show_image for nouns, log_vocabulary for new items). Contrast 'have' (keep it) vs 'borrow' (give it back) briefly in Chinese. Then run the activity.

items.chinese: 我可以借用你的……嗎?(借東西句型)

stages.activity: Role-play: at school, art class. You are the classmate. The student forgot their pencil case and must borrow things: 'Can I borrow your ___?' (glue, ruler, pen, scissors...). Sometimes answer 'Sure. Here you are.', sometimes 'No. Sorry.' so the student practices reacting to both.

stages.label: 總結
stages.goal: Wrap up in simple terms: today we learned 'Can I borrow your ___?' and the difference between have and borrow. Praise ONE specific thing. Tell them tomorrow is about asking PERMISSION at home. Say goodbye warmly.

week.focus: 動詞擴充 go/call/watch/listen + 在家請求允許場景

stages.label: 開場暖身
stages.goal: Greet the student BY NAME, ONE short small-talk question, then introduce today's topic: asking Mom or Dad for permission at home — not just for things, but for ACTIVITIES.

stages.label: 複習
stages.goal: Review these items, ONE at a time: prompt the student to use each, wait, gently fix by restating.

items.chinese: 氣球(第一天教的,再回收一次)

stages.label: 主題課程
stages.goal: Teach today's verbs ONE at a time (log_vocabulary each). Show how the SAME pattern 'Can I ___?' works with activity verbs. Then run the activity.

items.example: Can I go to the park?

stages.activity: Role-play: at home in the evening. YOU are the parent, the STUDENT asks for permission: 'Can I watch TV?' 'Can I listen to music?' 'Can I go to the park?'. Answer with 'Sure.' or 'No. Sorry.' plus a simple reason (e.g. 'It's late.'). Encourage the student to ask at least 3 different questions.

stages.label: 總結
stages.goal: Wrap up in simple terms: today the same 'Can I ___?' pattern worked for activities too. Praise ONE specific thing. Tell them tomorrow is the BIG final review game. Say goodbye warmly.

week.focus: 總複習 + 服裝店綜合大場景(含 suit/boots)

stages.label: 開場暖身
stages.goal: Greet the student BY NAME warmly, tell them today is the FINAL DAY of this unit: a big shopping game using everything from this week.

stages.label: 快問快答複習
stages.goal: Rapid review quiz, ONE at a time, keep the pace light and fun: prompt the student to produce each pattern or word, wait, gently fix by restating.

items.english: Sure. Here you are. / No. Sorry.

items.chinese: 看/聽/打電話/去(任選兩個造句)

stages.label: 綜合角色扮演
stages.goal: First teach the two new bonus nouns quickly (show_image + log_vocabulary), then run the big final activity using EVERYTHING from this week.
stages.activity: Big role-play: a clothes shop. You are the shopkeeper. The student shops and must naturally use ALL patterns: 'Can I have...?' 'Can I buy the boots?' 'Can I borrow...?' and react to your 'Sure.' / 'No. Sorry.'. Then SWAP ROLES for one short round: the student is the shopkeeper. Make it playful.

stages.label: 本週總結
stages.goal: Celebrate finishing the whole unit! In Traditional Chinese, remind them of the 3 patterns learned this week, praise TWO specific improvements you noticed today, and say a warm goodbye.
